title: U.S. Senate confirms Schiess to lead Space Force

summary: Chinese launch startup Orienspace is preparing for an IPO and has secured funding to accelerate development of its reusable Gravity-2 rocket. The Shandong-based company aims to advance its commercial launch capabilities.

title: NASA and Roscosmos continue seat barter agreement
summary: NASA and Roscosmos have extended their seat barter agreement for crew exchanges between Soyuz and Crew Dragon spacecraft. The agreement does not currently include Boeing's Starliner.

summary: NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Anil Menon conducted a 6.5-hour spacewalk to install solar array mounting hardware on the International Space Station. This mission is part of preparations for an upcoming solar array upgrade.

title: SpaceX rocket's impact crater on the moon spied by Korean lunar orbiter (photos)

summary: Blue Origin identified a faulty oxygen valve as the cause of a significant explosion during the New Glenn rocket's first-stage engine test. The company reports substantial progress in its investigation into the anomaly.

summary: NASA's Lunar Development and Test Facility at Johnson Space Center is preparing Artemis hardware to withstand the harsh lunar environment, focusing on the challenges posed by Moon dust, which is sharp, abrasive, and clinging.

summary: NASA's CosmicDS project, led by Harvard University, collaborated with the Smithsonian Institution's BEST AQI project to engage educators and teens in analyzing TEMPO satellite data for local air quality investigations. The event took place from July 27–29, 2026.

title: JOB OPPORTUNITIES: NASA OFFICE OF THE GENERAL COUNSEL
summary: NASA's Office of the General Counsel is offering job opportunities. This could attract legal professionals interested in space industry roles.

summary: The latest APOD features the sharpest image of the Sun ever captured, revealing new insights into solar instability. This discovery is part of ongoing efforts to better understand solar phenomena.

summary: NASA has moved up the launch date for the Crew-13 mission to the ISS. The pilot of Crew-13 reflects on their career, training, and the upcoming science mission ahead of the flight.

summary: SpaceX is recovering Ship 40 after its soft landing in the Indian Ocean, while Ship 41 prepares for testing ahead of Flight 14.

summary: SpaceX has conducted two flights from the newly designed Pad 2 at Starbase. Meanwhile, retrofitting work is underway at Pad 1 to support Block 3 flights.

summary: The U.S. Space Force awarded $615 million in contracts for Space Based Airborne Moving Target Indication (SB-AMTI) to Rocket Lab, STR LLC, and others. The contracts were issued under the Space Systems Command (SSC) using Other Transaction Authority.

summary: L3Harris Technologies confirmed the successful deployment of its first perimeter truss reflector on the ViaSat-3 Flight 3 satellite, which was launched by SpaceX in late April. This marks the third deployment in Viasat's ViaSat-3 satellite series.
